s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive retinal vascular proliferation with macular edema resolution
salient_findings: Macular edema resolution after intravitreal anti-VEGF injections
Hyperreflective tissues proliferating on retinal vessels on OCTA
Dendritic vascular-like structures on Fluorescein Angiography
key_facts: 76-year-old woman presented with macular edema
Treated with 2 intravitreal anti-VEGF injections
Macular edema completely resolved at 3 months
No recurrence of macular edema
OCTA findings at 6 months showed no abnormality
OCTA findings at 12 months showed hyperreflective tissues on retinal vessels
OCTA findings at 15 months showed increased hyperreflective tissues with angiogenic sprouts
OCTA findings at 18 months showed development in area of preexisting proliferation
OCTA findings at 21 months showed enlarged horizontal structures along retina surface
Fluorescein Angiography at 21 months showed dendritic vascular-like structures

differentials: Primary central nervous system lymphoma with ocular involvement
per_call: Primary central nervous system lymphoma with ocular involvement

shortlist.label: Coats disease
shortlist.why_kept: Characterized by abnormal blood vessel growth in the retina, matching the patient's OCTA findings of hyperreflective tissues and angiogenic sprouts

shortlist.label: Retinal angiomatous proliferation
shortlist.why_kept: Matches the patient's presentation of retinal vascular proliferation and macular edema resolution

shortlist.label: Choroidal neovascularization
shortlist.why_kept: Could explain the patient's OCTA findings of hyperreflective tissues and angiogenic sprouts, although less specific to the syndrome frame

shortlist.label: Eales disease
shortlist.why_kept: Characterized by retinal vascular inflammation and neovascularization, which could be related to the patient's findings

shortlist.label: Retinal capillary hemangioblastoma
shortlist.why_kept: Although rare, this condition involves abnormal blood vessel growth in the retina, which aligns with the patient's OCTA findings

raw.rationale: The sequential development of hyperreflective tissues and angiogenic sprouts on retinal vessels observed in OCTA findings, along with the presence of dendritic vascular-like structures in Fluorescein Angiography, are characteristic of retinal angiomatous proliferation.

rejected.label: Coats disease
rejected.why: Typically presents in young males with significant retinal exudation, which is not mentioned in the case.

rejected.label: Choroidal neovascularization
rejected.why: Involves new vessel growth from the choroid, not typically described as proliferations on retinal vessels as seen in OCTA.

rejected.label: Eales disease
rejected.why: Characterized by retinal vasculitis and neovascularization, often with a history of inflammation, which is not indicated in the case.

rejected.label: Retinal capillary hemangioblastoma
rejected.why: A distinct tumor-like lesion, which is not suggested by the sequential development of vascular proliferations described in the case.
